title: Ransomware in Chambourcy, France, claimed by the Incransom group
content_md:
Ransomware attack on Chambourcy, a commune in France's Yvelines department, claimed by the Incransom group. The post links to an Infonews Cyber report:

https://infonewscyber.fr/info/chambourcy-revendiquee-par-le-groupe-incransom-10f230cd8457ed1d

via Mastodon https://infonewscyber.fr/info/chambourcy-revendiquee-par-le-groupe-incransom-10f230cd8457ed1d
